name: agentic-economy-oracle
description: A privacy-preserving agentic economy testbed. A fleet of IronClaw agents each run a local MESA + NetworkX market simulation, contribute their encrypted interaction graphs to a shared NOVA group, and a central coordinator trains a GraphSAGE oracle on the aggregated graphs to learn system-level economic dynamics (market efficiency, cooperation, wealth inequality) without ever seeing any agent's raw data. Use this plugin when running the agentic economy oracle research experiment: it surfaces the MESA simulation internals, macro-signal time series, NOVA contribution flow, and oracle training state.
author: jcarbonnell

fleet_shape.description: An IronClaw agent that runs a local MESA market simulation each round, encrypts the resulting interaction graph, and contributes it to the shared NOVA swarm group via the nova-economy-contributor skill. Homogeneous fleet: every agent plays the same role but produces independent simulation outcomes.

personalization.label: Traders per simulation
personalization.description: How many trading agents run inside each agent's local MESA model per round (default 8).

personalization.label: Strategy mix
personalization.description: The distribution of trading strategies (cooperative, defector, hoarder, etc.) assigned across the MESA traders. Shapes the economic dynamics the oracle learns from.
